conventions.actual_encoding: Known byte encoding used to author the fixture; GBK is a subset of GB18030 and is not uniquely detectable. UTF-8 BOM is counted separately.
conventions.coordinates: final_board rows run from SGF y=a downward; columns run from x=a rightward.
conventions.mainline: Follow the first child at each node; count moves including passes and illegal move nodes.
conventions.branches: root_branch_count counts direct children of the root, including a single continuation.
conventions.captures: captured_by records stones removed by moves, not AE; self-capture credits the opponent.
conventions.metadata: Missing komi and rules are null, missing handicap is 0. rules_raw is the raw RU value after decoding, without normalization.
conventions.collections: Each file has a games array, in collection order; counts and boards belong to each game.
conventions.manual: Manual exceptions have independent hand-authored expectations in tools/fixture-oracle/manual.py, pinned to exact SGF bytes. No fallback from automatic to manual.
